# ScriptVector

*Common*

Three-dimensional vector: a position, rotation, direction or size, from `scram.vector(x, y, z)` or returned by the API. Math methods return a new vector and keep this one unchanged.

## Fields

### x {#x}

::: member

X component.

**Type** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number)

:::

### y {#y}

::: member

Y component.

**Type** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number)

:::

### z {#z}

::: member

Z component.

**Type** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number)

:::

## Methods

### add {#add}

::: member

```js
var above = c.getPlayer().getPosition().add(scram.vector(0, 2, 0));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `other` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | other vector, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the sums of the components

:::

### subtract {#subtract}

::: member

```js
// Direction from the player to the target
var direction = target.getPosition().subtract(c.getPlayer().getPosition()).normalize();
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `other` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | other vector, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the differences of the components

:::

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scalar` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | factor |

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with every component multiplied by the factor

:::

### cross {#cross}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vector` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | other vector, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector perpendicular to both, the cross product; its length is the area of their parallelogram

:::

### length {#length}

::: member

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — length of the vector, the distance from 0, 0, 0

:::

### normalize {#normalize}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the same direction and length 1; NaN components if this vector has zero length

:::

### toBlockPos {#toblockpos}

::: member

**Returns** `BlockPos` — Minecraft block position, for Java code; components are truncated toward zero, so -0.5 becomes 0, not -1

:::

:::

### toVector3d {#tovector3d}

::: member

:::

### toString {#tostring}

### toArrayString {#toarraystring}

### lerp {#lerp}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
